disclosure: The validation block [70:80] was scored in round one (2026-10-21) and its results were seen before this registration. The test block [80:100] was spent in round one and is never scored in round two. Every round-two verdict needs forward confirmation.
arbiter: validation[70:80] of the round-one pinned rows; test[80:100] spent and never used
cost_basis: GROSS of cost -- statistical skill only, never a trading result

range.definition: sigma = E|r| x sqrt(pi/2) from the frozen LSTM volatility forecast; range = as-of close x exp(+/- q_t x sigma / 100); q_t by adaptive conformal inference (gamma 0.005, window {'H1': 500, 'D1': 250}) from past settled |z| only; the first `window` validation rows warm up and are not scored
range.baseline: GARCH sigma (h1_garch_hod / d1_garch) with the static normal quantile, same rows
range.verdict: CLEARED iff the two-sided (1 - alpha) paired moving-block bootstrap CI of mean(winkler_baseline - winkler_model) at the 80% level has lower bound > 0 AND the 80% coverage is within +/-3% of target; else DROP. The 95 % level and a static-Gaussian LSTM range are reported, not decisive.

inputs.timing: FRED values dated on or before the previous US business day; MT5 bars labelled on or before the gold D1 bar; forward-fill only

macro.baseline: the same model and hyperparameters without the macro block, on identical rows
macro.verdict: vol and range: CLEARED iff the paired bootstrap CI of mean(|err_without| - |err_with|) (Winkler for range) has lower bound > 0; return: CLEARED iff the one-sided Clark-West p < alpha against the model without macro; else DROP.

selective.tau: largest |p - 0.5| keeping inner-fold training coverage >= the floor

direction2.baselines: training-majority class and a 50 % coin, on the same scored rows
direction2.verdict: CLEARED iff both paired bootstrap CIs (vs majority, vs coin) have lower bound > 0; abstentions and time-outs are never scored; else DROP.

expected_outcomes.h1_range: likely CLEARED: it rides on the h1_lstm volatility edge that cleared validation and test
expected_outcomes.d1_range: uncertain: the d1_lstm volatility edge cleared validation but not the test block
expected_outcomes.d1_lstm_macro:vol: likely DROP: 346 validation days leave little room to show a paired gain
expected_outcomes.d1_lstm_macro:ret: DROP expected: no gold return cell has ever cleared
expected_outcomes.d1_gbm_macro:ret: DROP expected: no gold return cell has ever cleared
expected_outcomes.d1_range_macro: likely DROP, for the same reason as d1_lstm_macro:vol
expected_outcomes.h1_selective: DROP expected: round-one H1 direction sat at a coin; abstaining rarely creates an edge
